words_common.academic_abstracts::38: Cell damage in the middle part of the brain are follow-up injuries caused by big jumps in chemical levels in the brain and are linked to bleeding around the brain. However, their medical meaning in bleeding patients stays unclear. We looked back at bleeding patients who were helped in our hospital and checked group differences in the backgrounds, medical findings, and results between bleeding patients who developed cell damage in the middle part of the brain and those who did not. We further compared patients who reached good results with those who had poor results. Complex math analysis was used to find risk factors for poor medical results. We looked at 159 bleeding patients; 17 patients (10.7%) had cell damage in the middle part of the brain. Patients with cell damage in the middle part of the brain were more likely to be in a bad condition (World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies grading IV-V: odds ratio [OR], 4.53; 95% confidence interval [95% CI]: 1.60-12.84; p = 0.0042) and have a bleed inside the brain cavities (OR, 5.98; 95% CI: 1.32-27.13; p = 0.0054) or a bleed deep inside the brain tissue (OR, 3.62; 95% CI: 1.25-10.45; p = 0.023). Patients with cell damage in the middle part of the brain had a higher chance of a poor result 3 months after the start (modified Rankin Scale score 0-2: OR, 0.22; 95% CI: 0.07-0.66; p = 0.0043). Complex math analysis confirmed that cell damage in the middle part of the brain raised the risk of a poor result (OR, 4.39; 95% CI: 1.06-18.1; p = 0.037). The start of cell damage in the middle part of the brain may be tied to the size of bleeds in bleeding patients. Although they are usually fixable injuries, the start of cell damage in the middle part of the brain may be a sign of poor results in bleeding patients.
words_common.academic_abstracts::39: Information on correct steps for calming Nordestino donkeys is rare. To look at the calming and heart and lung effects of small amounts of liquid xylazine given in a vein with and without acepromazine in Nordestino donkeys. Seven healthy female Nordestino donkeys weighing about 150 kilograms were used in this hidden, mixed, back and forth study. Four plans were used, made of two shots in a vein, at the start and 15 minutes later. Plans included acepromazine plus salt water, salt water plus xylazine, acepromazine plus xylazine or acepromazine plus a larger amount of xylazine. Calming and heart and lung signs were checked before the start and 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 minutes after the treatment. Level of head height above ground and quality of calming like walking trouble, reactions to sounds or touch and a simple visual score and breathing speed were checked by the lead person on site, and heart speed was measured by a helper. Three expert judges watched videos for walking trouble and reactions to touch. Normal data were looked at by standard math tests. Head height was lower than the start for 15 minutes after xylazine was given in the small dose group and for 30 minutes in the other two groups. All plans with xylazine raised the visual score and walking trouble on site for 15 minutes after giving the drug, with no big differences between groups. Walking trouble on site was higher in the larger dose groups than the first group for 15 and 30 minutes. Missing a group with no drug. Acepromazine added to xylazine at the lower dose made shorter and lighter calming than xylazine at the higher dose level.
words_common.academic_abstracts::40: ALMA-IMF looked at 15 big groups of baby stars down to a size of 2,000 units, finding about 1,000 centers where stars are born. The weight and brightness of these centers, which are basic physical features, are hard to find, a problem made much worse at the distances over 2,000 units of ALMA-IMF groups. We joined new data sets and computer models of light movement to describe these centers. We guessed their average heat and the weight these guesses mean. For one sixth of the group, we measured the total brightness, using fixes to separate light when needed. We used a way to look at how light is spread out found with a math method, which aims to keep the best clear view of the input data. We used the brightness and dust heat pictures given by this method at a low clear view to guess those of single centers, which were found at a higher clear view. To do this, we used rough rules about light between the brightness of a baby star and the heat of its cover and between the outside heating of stars before they form and their heat. For the first time, we give facts based on data for dust heat for 883 centers found with ALMA-IMF: 17 to 31 degrees and 28 to 79 degrees for the 617 centers before stars and 266 centers with stars. We also measured star brightness from 20 to 80,000 times the sun. For hot centers, we guessed lower heat than studies based on complex carbon parts. We made a weight and brightness growth chart, for the first time at the center size level and for a large group of heavy star centers. The ALMA-IMF data likes a story where baby stars take their weight from a larger supply than their home centers.
words_common.academic_abstracts::41: The goal of this current study was to look into the role of miR-27a-3p in joint disease. Lab tests and protein analysis were done to find the amount of miR-27a-3p and ADAMTS5 in joint tissues from patients with joint disease and healthy people, and also in human joint cells treated with IL-1beta. Human joint cells were given miR-27a-3p. A test was used to confirm the direct link between miR-27a-3p and its target spot in the ADAMTS5 gene. Also, the effects of IL-1beta-caused activation of specific protein pathways on miR-27a-3p were looked at using blockers. The results showed that the level of miR-27a-3p was lower in joint disease tissues compared with those of normal people. In addition, lower miR-27a-3p and higher ADAMTS5 levels were seen based on the time and amount of treatment in cells treated with IL-1beta. Furthermore, adding more miR-27a-3p stopped the growth of ADAMTS5 in human cells caused by IL-1beta. More miR-27a-3p also lowered the activity of the ADAMTS5 reporter. Changing the miR-27a-3p target spot in the ADAMTS5 gene stopped the miR-27a-3p-led control of reporter activity. Furthermore, the use of specific blockers showed that IL-1beta may control miR-27a-3p levels using certain cell pathways in joint cells. This study concluded that miR-27a-3p was lower in human joint disease and was stopped by IL-1beta, and works as a key controller of ADAMTS5 in joint cells. In addition, IL-1beta-led loss of miR-27a-3p activity may happen using these cell pathways. The present study may provide a new way for medical treatment of joint disease caused by increasing miR-27a-3p. This research helps us understand joint health much better than we did before today.
words_common.academic_abstracts::42: Space weathering is a way that changes the top of airless space objects. Main space weathering causes are sun wind hitting and tiny rock hitting. These ways change how light bounces off space objects and often change their makeup signs. In this work we focused on copying and comparing the light changes caused by sun wind hitting and by tiny rock hitting to get a better grasp of these separate space weathering ways. We used olivine and pyroxene small balls as stand-ins for space materials. To copy sun wind hitting we used hydrogen, helium, and argon charged bits with energy from 5 to 40 keV and amounts of up to 10 to the power of 18 bits per square centimeter. To copy tiny rock hitting we used single very fast laser flashes. We looked at the matching growth of different light markers, which we found by using the Modified Gaussian Model, and we also did main part analysis. The original rock makeup of the top changes the light growth more than the weathering cause, as seen from the varied growth of the light slope of olivine and pyroxene upon hitting. The light slope changes seen in olivine match with views of A-type asteroids, while the middle to no slope changes seen in pyroxene match with asteroid (4) Vesta. We also saw some differences in the light effects made by the two weathering causes. Charged bits acting like sun wind have a smaller pull on longer light waves than laser flashes acting like tiny rock hits. This is most likely due to the different deep reach of charged bits and laser flashes. Our results show that in some cases it might be possible to tell the two causes apart on a weathered surface.
words_common.academic_abstracts::43: HEALPix by Gorski et. al. (2005) is the main way for Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data storage and study, and is widely used in current and future CMB tests. Almost all the data sets in Legacy Archive for Microwave Background Data Analysis (LAMBDA) use HEALPix as a format of choice. Looking at the data plays an important role in research, and several tool sets were made to do that with HEALPix maps, most notably original Fortran tools and Python connection with healpy. With the current state of graphics card speed, it is now possible to look at extremely large maps in real time on a laptop or a tablet. HEALPix Viewer described here is made for macOS, and takes full advantage of graphics card speed to handle extremely large data sets in real time. It works natively on Intel and Arm64 computer types, and uses the Apple Metal system for high-speed graphics card math. The goal of this project is to reduce the work needed for interactive data looking, as well as time waste for making high quality maps for papers. Drag and drop connection with Keynote and Powerpoint makes creating presentations easy. The main code is written in Swift, a modern and fast language, with high-speed computing parts given entirely to the graphics card, and a few parts in C talking to the cfitsio library for reading and writing. The visual control screen is written in SwiftUI, a new easy way to build screens based on Swift. Most common round projections and color maps are supported right away, and the open code makes it easy to change the app and to add new features if needed. Overall speed is better than the current Python software by three to one hundred eighty times depending on the task.
words_common.academic_abstracts::44: To compare the neck of the womb stiffness measurement by using internal ultrasound between twin and single pregnant women. This was a forward looking group study involving the twin and single pregnant women who went to the pregnancy care at Ramathibodi Hospital, Bangkok, Thailand. The people who met the set rules were regularly measured for the speed of sound waves by using internal ultrasound at early, middle, and third parts of pregnancy. The changes in speed with moving pregnancy time between twin and single pregnancies were checked. The time of birth and natural early birth rate were also looked at. A total of 36 twin pregnancies and 38 single pregnancies were checked. No big difference in starting features, except the age of people (twin pregnancies 33.1±4.6 years, single pregnancies 29.9±5.4 years, p-value = 0.006) was seen. The neck of the womb speed decreased with moving pregnancy time in both twin and single pregnancy, but there was a math based big difference of speed at the lower point in the middle part (twin pregnancies 2.27±0.4, single pregnancies 2.71±0.6 m/s, p-value = 0.001). However, no big difference in speed at the upper point and the lower point in the early and third part was shown. Even though the time of birth between both groups showed a big difference (twin pregnancies 35.9±2.8, single pregnancies 37.6±2.9 weeks, p-value = 0.008) but the natural early birth rate did not differ much (twin pregnancies 22.2%, single pregnancies 15.8%, p-value = 0.483). The middle part speed measurement at the lower point finds the difference in neck of the womb softness between twin and single pregnancies. The speed might be an extra choice for watching the change in softness in twin pregnancies.
words_common.academic_abstracts::45: Chromosome count is a main part of how the genetic material is built, and shifts in chromosome count play a basic role in how life changes over time. Small gains and losses in chromosome count, as well as events where the whole set of chromosomes doubles, may lead to groups being unable to breed and the creation of new types of life. The recent creation of math models of chromosome count change in the important work by Mayrose et al. (2010, ChromEvol) have let us guess the old chromosome counts over family trees and created new interest in studying the role of chromosome changes in how life changes. However, the ChromEvol way assumes all changes happen slowly along the branches of the tree, and does not model events that happen specifically when one group splits into two. Splits might be expected if chromosome changes result in groups being unable to breed. Here we show a new class of models of chromosome count change (called ChromoSSE) that include both slow changes and changes during splits. The ChromoSSE models allow us to find the way of chromosome count change; is chromosome change happening mostly within single lines, mostly at the point of a split, or in specific mixes of both? Also, we can guess the place and time of possible chromosome events that create new types over the family tree. We put ChromoSSE in a math framework, in the software RevBayes, to handle doubt in our guesses while using the full power of math methods. We tested ChromoSSE with fake data and looked again at chromosome change in Aristolochia, Carex section Spirostachyae, Helianthus, Mimulus, and Primula section Aleuritia, finding proof for specific mixes of slow and fast ways of chromosome change.
words_common.academic_abstracts::46: We show results of our change over time studies of magnesium and aluminum absorption lines in a group of 22 low ionization broad absorption line quasars at 0.2 to 2.1 using the 2 meter telescope at IUCAA Girawali Observatory over a period of 10 days to 7.69 years in the quasar's own frame. Data are studied along with brightness changes from Catalina Real-Time Transient Survey. Long period absorption line change is seen in 8 cases while only 4 of them show change over short periods. We notice a tendency of highly changing quasars to have high speed movement away, low strength and low distance. The rate of finding change in quasars showing iron fine lines is less than that seen in other quasars. Absorption line change is more frequently found in quasars having light dominated by iron emission lines compared to rest of the quasars. Confirming these trends with a bigger group will give important clues for understanding the physical difference between different quasar sub-groups. We link the absorption line change with various values taken from brightness curves and find no clear link between brightness level and absorption line changes. However, sources with large absorption line change also show large change in their brightness curves. We also see appearance or disappearance of absorption parts in 2 cases and clear signs for shape changes in 4 cases. The observed change can be best explained by a mix of process driven by brightness changes and clouds moving across the line of sight. These findings help us better understand the nature of these objects and how they behave over many years of observation in the deep dark sky.
words_common.academic_abstracts::47: The red light from glowing gas clouds is a great way to track new star birth in galaxies. With the start of JWST, this light has recently become visible at very high distances for the first time. We show a list of 1013 light sources at these distances in the GOODS areas found from a wide search in JWST NIRCam tool data. We use the FRESCO study's large area of views in GOODS-North and GOODS-South with the F444W filter, checking for light at these distances; and the CONGRESS study's smaller area in GOODS-North with F356W, checking for light at other distances. We find a crowded area with 97 sources at one distance in GOODS-N and confirm earlier reported crowded areas at other distances in GOODS-N and in GOODS-S. We calculate the seen light brightness levels in three groups at these distances, which are the first such measurements at these ranges found based only on light data, clearly tracking galaxy star birth rates beyond the peak of the cosmic star birth history. We compare our results with guessed ideas from three different computer models and find good agreement at these distances. The light brightness levels of this confirmed group are in good agreement with older measurements found with color-selected objects. Finally, we get star birth rate functions and add these to calculate the change of the cosmic star-birth rate levels across these distances, finding values in good agreement with recent light estimates from distant galaxies, which show a steady drop in star birth rates by three times over these distances. Our work shows the power of NIRCam tool observations to well provide new tests for early galaxy formation models based on light statistics.
words_common.academic_abstracts::48: Many studies have shown that cell damage from oxygen is closely linked with the start and growth of depression. Xiaoyao Pills are listed in the official book of Chinese medicines and are often used to treat worry and sadness by calming the liver, helping the stomach, and feeding the blood. However, the mood-lifting effects of these pills have not yet been fully studied. The goal of our study was to look at the mood-lifting effects of the pills and the hidden internal process in the brain-damaged rat model of depression using the open field test, sugar water test, grooming test, and the new food test. Results showed that the pills at low and high doses clearly helped the sad behaviors in rats, which was shown by more interest in sugar water, longer cleaning time, less running around, and faster eating in the food test. In addition, the pill treatment greatly fixed the low activity of protective enzymes and the lower level of antioxidants, while also lowering levels of harmful waste products, a swelling helper, and swelling proteins in the blood and brain outer layer of the rats. In terms of how it works, the pills caused a clear increase in the genetic and protein activity levels of many helpful markers, and a decrease of harmful oxygen molecules in the brain layers through the turning on of specific cell paths. These findings suggest that the pills have mood-lifting effects in rats with depression signs, and these effects happen by lowering cell damage and boosting brain-protecting effects through the turning on of the main growth and survival signaling pathways in the brain.
words_common.academic_abstracts::49: We report the finding of 16 separate small red stars that block each other with J<16 brightness and provide a deep look at three of them, using very exact heat light patterns from the WFCAM Transit Survey. Such groups give the most correct and simple way for measuring the basic features of these little known yet many stars, which currently lack enough looks to correctly fix star growth ideas. We fully solve for the weight and size of three of the groups, finding circle times in the range 1.5 to 4.9 days, with weights spanning 0.35 to 0.50 solar weights and sizes between 0.38 to 0.50 solar sizes, with errors of about 3.5 to 6.4 percent in weight and 2.7 to 5.5 percent in size. Close partners in short time circles are expected to be locked by gravity into fast spinning speeds, causing high levels of magnetic power. This is thought to puff up their sizes by blocking heat flow and increasing dark spot coverage. The sizes of the WFCAM Transit Survey groups are puffed up above model guesses by about 3 to 12 percent, in line with the seen trend, despite an expected lower general help from dark spot signs at heat light wave lengths. We looked for a link between the circle time and size puffing by joining our results with all existing small red star size measurements of similar exactness, but we found no clear proof for a drop in size puffing for longer time, less active groups. Size puffing still exists in systems not locked together showing that the problem stays even for very low activity small red stars. Fixing this issue is key for knowing the most common stars in the Universe, and for knowing their planet partners, which hold the best hope for finding Earth-like worlds in the usual livable area.

This INTERDESIGN YORK BATHROOM SHOWER CADDY, EXTRA LARGE (Satin Finish) is a wonderful shower holder, with two big, wide, high-sided baskets for lotion and shampoo bottles, as well as lots of hooks for razors, bath sponges, and the like. It comes with two big suction cups, and a very useful non-slip wire clip that goes around the shower pipe (after you hang the holder over the pipe) to hold the holder hook in place. The satin finish is dull metallic gold-toned, and the entire holder will not rust.

However, this Extra Large model is too big for my shower stall. The vertical basket supports are 8 inches wide, which is about half an inch too wide, because my shower wall has a built-in soap dish that gets in the way, even though the baskets are placed far enough apart to clear the dish. Also, the extra large holder is 26 inches long, which makes it hang down over the pullout shower control knob located below the shower pipe in the shower stall wall.

Happily, a very similar, but smaller INTERDESIGN YORK LYRA SHOWER CADDY is also available (see this same product page), and it fits my hard-to-fit shower stall perfectly! The lower basket is not as high-edged as the upper basket, but both baskets hold large bottles of soap, shampoo, lotion, etc. I love having even one high-edged basket, because it safely holds the shampoo and conditioner tubes that I was constantly knocking off my old holder's shallow tray (usually breaking the plastic caps on impact).

The vertical supports for the smaller holder (the York Lyra model) are 7-1/2 inches apart, and they fit flat against the shower wall (clearing the built-in soap dish). The wide spacing of the two shelves also provides room for the soap dish. The smaller model is 4 inches shorter than the Extra Large, so the holder's hooks stop just above the pullout shower control knob. I ordered the York Lyra model in silver finish, which is dull metallic silver-toned, because silver goes better with my shiny metal shower parts. The York Lyra model will not rust, and also comes with two big suction cups and a non-slip wire clip to secure the holder hook.

Both of the two Interdesign York shower holders on this product page are excellent. Just be sure to measure your shower area or shower stall before you order, so that you end up with the correct size for your space.

The flat corner on this wooden spoon makes it easy to clean the bottom of your pot or pan, and not miss spots, when you are mixing something that burns easily. I really love it for making caramel ice cream, because the browned sugar forms a lump and sticks to the bottom of the pan after I add cool cream. With this flat-edged spoon, it is easy to mix the lump and cream into a smooth caramel sauce without burning any of the browned sugar.

This light spoon is made of beechwood, and is nicely shaped and balanced. It is very comfortable to pick up, and to hold when you are mixing a sauce or gravy. The handle has a small bend, unlike the usual wooden spoon with a round, stiff straight handle that you are likely to find at the grocery store (for example, [[ASIN:B0019R9QKI HIC Harold Import Beechwood Spoon 12-Inch]]).

Wooden spoons are not dishwasher safe: they will quickly dry out and crack if washed in a dishwasher. Even if they are hand washed, they should be oiled with plain oil from time to time, to prevent cracking and make their useful life last. One fairly priced oil sold for this purpose is [[ASIN:B00280MY7M Snow River 7V03401 32-Ounce Wood Oil]].

I love this game but it is not a game to simply grab and play with just anyone. It took me about three or more hours to learn how to play and a few one or two hour sessions before I really understood it and there is probably still something I am missing. The game is fun and simple once you understand how to play but it is very difficult and could easily confuse new players. There is just a lot to keep track of. There are many moments where we stop and ask if there is anything we missed which makes the game feel like it is going slower.

Also, while I think they did a good job on some parts of the rulebook, like showing how to set up the game with pictures and having a list of topics, I think in many ways the rulebook could have been done better. I often have to flip through several different pages to better understand one thing and I will feel like I still did not get an answer.

The game is supposedly made to stop bossy players but there is really no built-in way to stop slow players. My current regular partner, despite having played several games, has me help them through almost every single step for their own turn and asks for my help to the point that I cannot focus on my own turn until they are done with theirs. When I ask for help for just a small part of my turn, whether due to being a poor team player or not having the confidence with the rules, it is not returned and then I am somehow a bother to them for taking too long because I am finally able to set up my own turn. Granted, I might not have the best partner right now but hosting a game night, especially with multiple new players, currently seems like a nightmare. So with that, it is great for playing alone! Again, I love the game.

I just opened this package of six hooks this morning and am so very happy. I used hooks like this style quite a few years ago and found them totally strong enough for hanging plants, lamps, and so on.

I want to hang various plants around the house and decided to go with this six-pack of hooks. There were several options out there in the Amazon store, but this particular product seemed like a good fit for me.

They arrived really fast and everything was packed so well. Each hook came in its own little protective bag (so no issues with scratches or marks), and another larger bag held various screws, plastic pieces, wall fasteners, and so on. I counted everything and it was all there.

You pick the parts specific to whatever material you are screwing into (stone, wood, wall board). My hooks will mostly go in wall board ceilings, so the wall fasteners are my choice.

I was a little worried about the look or style of this hook looking a bit too old like my last one. Because I chose the white color this time, they look so much more new and simple. They should blend in really well with my white ceilings. I really like the way they look!

I have a six foot PowerLine cable that is just about a year old. That is twice as long as any other cable, covered in cloth, strong, or whatever, has lasted. Where I keep my tablet in the pocket of the side bar on my bed puts a fairly sharp bend in cables. I have had them breaking and tearing at the plug as soon as a week and never more than two or three months. I am replacing the six foot cable for two reasons. The six foot cable just is not long enough, it is really close and the ten foot cable is going to be more than I need but I think it is better to have the extra length. The cable has developed a permanent bend at the small end but still shows no signs of breaking or tearing. The other reason is the part that plugs in has loosened up a little which I have noticed in both my tablet and Kindle but it still works so it is a good extra cable to have around. The new cable ends are very tight fitting which I am happy with, the old one was getting a little too easy to pop loose but it got a lot of usage so I really cannot complain seeing as how much longer the six foot cable lasted. If this ten footer lasts that long I will be quite happy.

Update 01/23/2018 - I bought this 10 foot cable based on how long the company's 6 foot cable of the same style lasted. My 6 foot cable lasted nearly a year of numerous daily times plugging and unplugging my tablet. With no clear change in usage or handling the 10 foot cable is now disconnecting from the tablet at the lightest touch after less than three months. Very sad.

Update: 02/08/2018 - I contacted Anker about help for this cable. They were very quick to respond, friendly, concerned and quickly sent me a better cable to make up for this cable failing. Messages were never delayed, response times were generally 12 to 24 hours apart. If you get a bad one Anker will support their product.
words_common.amazon_reviews::17:
When I ordered two of these TEMPUR-PEDIC COMFORTPILLOW TRAVEL PILLOWS (One Size, Beige), one pillow turned out to be too full (very fat, heavy, and rather hard), and the other turned out to be perfect (moderately flat and flexible). Both are excellent small pillows, though the fat one is more suitable for a back support pillow or propping-up pillow than a travel pillow.

Why are the two pillows so different? It is because they are NOT solid-piece pillows like my wonderful [[ASIN:B07CMK551C full-size Tempur-Pedic Symphony Pillow]], which is a one hundred percent shaped soft foam pad. Instead, the travel pillows consist of seventy percent cut-up soft foam and thirty percent soft foam pad.

My fat pillow obviously received more cut-up foam during making than the more flexible pillow. Because cut-up foam tends to move around in pillows, I try to avoid pillows with cut-up foam inside. In fact, I would not have bought the two travel pillows had I known that they were not solid pieces.

However, I like my two travel pillows pretty well--so far the inside has not moved. They are good quality pillows made with Tempur-Pedic memory foam that shapes to one's body. They work for me because the small size is very good for propping up an arm or leg in bed, or for providing spot support for back, neck, or shoulders in a chair.
words_common.amazon_reviews::18:
My coworker and I laughed when we found a link to this banana slicer on Amazon and asked each other "How hard can it be to slice a banana?" Well, about one week later I came across this exact slicer in a kitchen tool store and knew I had to buy it. Now I am not laughing any longer, because:

- A medium-size banana can be sliced in four pushes through the tool.
- All slices are a perfect quarter inch wide.
- If you use a machine to dry out your own fruits, this slicer makes sure all the banana pieces are the same size so that they dry at the same time.
- Even banana slices on jello, cereal, or desserts make for great looks when serving food to guests.

Cleaning is easy as long as you use a brush; otherwise it can be difficult to clean the sharp parts well. Of course, use care when cleaning and do not leave this tool around children as they can put their fingers in the hole and get hurt when squeezing the handles--but this is just common sense for any kitchen tool.

For a person who uses a drying machine or just wants nice-looking banana slices, this is a must have. For others, it is a great talking point and handy tool. For those who slice one banana every so often, do not bake or use a dryer or have no one to talk with, then this would be a silly purchase.

Personally, I love it!
words_common.amazon_reviews::19:
Pros:

1. Simple to set up - no tools needed. Just attach the metal mount to the hole at the bottom of the camera and turn the screw. (And check every so often that it is still tight)

2. Fits a lot more comfortably than a normal neck strap. All big cameras should come with this type of strap. No neck pain or awkward carrying positions.

3. Can be pulled tight against the body by pulling on the ring and camera (in opposite directions) for when you need to go hands free across some hard ground (or when your hands are busy)

4. Can be worn on either shoulder or even behind your back as needed.

5. There is a locking part to hold the strap in place when you are not shooting.

6. Strap moves itself and gets longer when you raise the camera to take a shot (when the lock is off of course)

7. This strap is built for a man, (the women's strap has a small curve for the curvy photographer) but it is still comfortable (and strong enough) no matter who you are.

Cons:

1. Hanging an expensive camera and even more expensive lens upside down, from ONE screw, in ONE spot, on the bottom of the camera, is a bit scary. (But regular straps can break also)

2. Strap could have been made better with a bit more soft padding.

3. Strap takes up quite a bit of space in a camera bag (but you cannot have everything) For smaller bags you can take the strap off and put it back on when needed in a couple of seconds.

4. Obviously you have to take the strap off when you want to use a stand.

5. Not the fault of the strap, but the people in the video on the product page need some help on how to hold a big camera properly (ha ha)

Overall, this has solved a big problem for me, as this is a much more comfortable way to carry around a heavy camera and lens for hours at a time.

Amanda Richards, January 8, 2013

Note: I recently bought the women's version of this strap. The only difference is that the strap is a little bit narrower at the top, and has a clever little bend for fitting around a woman's body.
words_common.amazon_reviews::20: I bought these to use with Brain.fm. I would have preferred wireless but wireless models don't seem to be able to run all night eight hours on a charge. These are actually better than I expected in a couple ways - first, they sound surprisingly good for the price. The low sounds are fine and the sound is well balanced across the whole range you can hear. Second, the cord is a very bendy and strong cloth material. It does not knot and twist as easily as plastic and is made stronger at the plug end. The head strap is a light soft fuzzy material - it tends to be warm, but that would be a good thing outside in cold weather. The tiny speakers are fairly easy to move by sticking your finger into the slots made for that job. That is really my only complaint - there is nothing to really keep them firmly in place. They tend to move around easily when putting on or taking off the head strap. This pulls on the cord where it goes into the back of the head strap. It might be helpful to put a couple of stitches on either side of them to hold them in place. words_common.amazon_reviews::21:
I bought this little machine to replace both an old and grumpy five disc CD player and a single disc DVD player. I now have extra room in the old entertainment center, so even my very old record player can take a shaky spin every now and again.

Seeing that I cannot connect a toaster without help, I called on my reliable partner to solve the mystery of setting it up. In simple language, also known as plain English, this is what you need to know about this strong machine:

1. The instruction book needs a lot of work. It is neither simple to use nor impossible to mess up. The same goes for the boxy silver remote control.

2. It is easy to set up if you already know how to do that sort of thing. We have standard video connections to the TV and digital audio connections to the sound system.

3. It gives great sound from both CDs and DVDs. With the benefit of surround sound, movies like Master and Commander can truly move you, and CDs have never sounded better.

4. It is as useful as a five disc CD changer as it is a five disc DVD player, except that when you are playing more than one CD you will need to put it in CD mode first.

5. It can easily play different types of media, such as music CDs, MP3s, DVDs and those other mysterious types; just put in the discs and play away.

6. The picture quality is very good on a regular TV. You can set up different ready-made picture quality styles, or change them to suit your own taste if you are an expert or a fan. If you have difficulty making up your mind, ignore this option.

7. The player is very full of options, but you have to explore for yourself, which can be a bit confusing until you get the hang of it. Read the book, you say? See Item 1 above.

8. There is on-screen information for MP3s and photo CDs, with different views available for the contents, such as groups or folders or entire lists of songs.

9. I cannot comment on the advanced picture feature, since I do not have a high definition TV yet. I am still waiting for that lottery win.

10. It is supposed to play special high quality music discs, but you need six channel inputs on your sound system to play them. Unfortunately, our system is missing these inputs, but then again, I am also missing any of those music discs.

Electronics fans will probably say that it needs a bit of fixing to get it to look and sound just right, but it looks and sounds great to me. All in all a very good player, perhaps excellent when you factor in the low price.

Amanda Richards, October 1, 2004
words_common.amazon_reviews::22: I have had a lot of printers over the years (IBM, Epson, HP, Canon, Lexmark, and so on), and had kind of gone away from HP a bit due to their computer program and connection problems (when they moved the building and help to other countries, the quality slipped quite a bit). This is an absolutely gorgeous kettle. It is well made, strongly built, and overall a dream to use. 

POSITIVES
- It holds up to 2 quarts of water to the fill line.

- It is strongly built.

- It whistles softly when the water has reached a very hot boil.

- The top fits safely on the kettle but requires a little extra strength to put on and take off.

- It comes with a blue pad for holding hot things.

- It comes in seven wonderful colors--gray, cream, navy, a salmon color, yellow, deep green, and a light green.

NEGATIVES
- The last bit of water in the kettle gets caught under the edge unless one can center the flow through the pouring part. This means that I have to dry the inside with a towel for storage.

- The kettle is heavy; almost like a heavy metal pot.

- It requires a pad for holding hot things to use (opening of the pouring part, pouring, etc.) because the entire kettle gets very hot and that includes the handle and the part that lifts the lid. I also would have liked a glove for holding hot things the color of the kettle.

In short, I love this kettle despite its downsides. At this high price, supplying the user with a glove for holding hot things instead of a flat one in the color of the kettle one buys, would make the purchase feel much better. Note that I never heard of the Caraway brand before and saw this kettle in blue on the Vine program. Since ordering this through Vine would not provide me with much savings at the list price, I decided to order this when the price came down for a big sale day in the color I wanted. The Caraway site was cheaper that day by $4 (i.e. $176) but sort of required the purchase of insurance for $4.95. Therefore, I purchased this on Amazon for $180 plus tax, bringing this to $191.93. I still consider this expensive but this is the best made kettle I ever tried. It is right up there with Le Creuset pots and almost just as heavy too. This is a kettle that I expect to last my whole life. There are many kettles on the market that are less than $40 that also could last a lifetime but they are not as nice. I do hope it continues to meet my needs going forward. If it fails in any way, I will lower my rating, update my review, and will most likely be sorry about my purchase. As of now, I love this and took off one star due to the downsides.

UPDATE - I have been using this regularly for days now and I noticed that this takes longer to boil water than my other kettle and keeps the water warmer a little longer. I also noticed that if I put this on my burner that has a lower flame, the handle does not get hot when the boil is complete, so that is nice.

No one comes in that sliding glass door - it opens onto a screened in porch - so I am not worried about how strange it looks that I have a lock outside - haha.

This HAMILTON BEACH DIGITAL RICE COOKER (37518, Stainless Steel, 6-¾ cup yield for white rice) cooks perfect fluffy rice every time, and is a good family-sized rice cooker (enough rice for 4 persons). It has the same capacity as the [[ASIN:B071KPXVJ7 Hamilton Beach 37506 Model]], but has a swinging lid (with rubber seal, a nice steam hole, an outside water catcher, and a lid cover).

The nice lid of this Model 37518 causes steamed foods to cook in one-third to one-half of the time required by the simpler Model 37506, but the nice lid has NO effect on rice or cereal cooking times. The Model 37518 has a water catcher that must be emptied, as needed, during cooking. The lid cover is a part that must be taken off each time for washing. (The directions do not explain how to take off the lid cover, but it pulls straight off the peg that holds it.)

The Model 37518 allows you to set your own cooking times for Hot Cereal or Steam. This is not really needed, because the Model 37506 cooks both cereal and rice automatically, and steams food with the help of a cooking timer.

Most rice cookers do a good job of cooking rice--they have a heat sensor that touches the bottom of the cooking pot and turns the cooker off automatically when the water dries up and the pot heat rises. Some rice cookers--like this one--cook rice to better perfection than others, but rice cookers mostly differ in their buttons (ranging from simple on/off to extra-fancy multi-button digital screens), and in the amount of their cooked rice yield.

This rice cooker is sort of in the middle, regarding both buttons and yield. It will cook different kinds of rice (there is a chart for correct amounts of rice and water for long grain brown or white, jasmine, basmati, and so on). It will cook different cereals and grains (barley, oatmeal, Cream of Wheat, and so on). It will steam food (vegetables, chicken, seafood); and it will steam food and rice together.

The size of this cooker is good if you are making rice for a family of four, or if you are steaming foods for a family of two. I love it for the way it cooks fluffy rice and automatically keeps the rice warm for up to 12 hours. I also love it for cooking Cream of Wheat automatically without burning it on the bottom.

Cooking in a rice cooker takes longer than cooking on a stove or in a microwave. For example, 3 cups of uncooked white rice will take up to 45 minutes; 1-½ cups of Cream of Wheat, up to 37 minutes. But it is easy to start the rice cooker and let it work while you are preparing the rest of your meal.

The rice cooker comes with a standard rice cup measure (about ¾ cup U.S.), a rice-rinsing/steamer basket, and a plastic spoon. The cooking pot has an excellent surface that food does not stick to. The removable pieces are all hand washable in warm, soapy water; handwashing is very easy.

In choosing between this Model 37518 and the Model 37506, I prefer the latter (with a simple, vented glass lid, no water catcher, longer steaming times, and no ability to set custom cooking times). Both models are very good, but sometimes simpler is better.

words_common.amazon_reviews::40:
This is my favorite rolling pen of all time. I have tried much more costly pens and ink tubes - I still hold onto my LAMY's because I love the look - but nothing can beat the G2 0.5mm - the ink tube AND the pen.

I rub the marks off with a sharp metal tool. That is enough to make me feel fine about using this pen.

I used to use ink pens for everything, but I got back into riding bikes this year and that shakes up the pen in my pocket like a paint mixer at a hardware store. So I had to go back to rolling pens for when I am moving around. I tried really hard to find a nice pen but the closest I came was LAMY pens that can be made to take the G2 0.5mm ink tubes. And I still like the G2 pen better. I kind of hate the fact that my choice went to the cheapest, most common thing on the earth, but I have to either be honest and use the best thing for me, or risk becoming a person who tries too hard to be cool laughing out loud.

I picked the 0.5mm ink tube pretty early on. It writes a great line and has the best feel for me on the paper I use. I usually buy just the ink tubes and keep using the same pen, but I lost my last G2 on a trip and figured a 12-pack is probably a lifetime supply for me. I have been using this motor for just over three years now. I thought the cost was a bit high for what it is, but it was worth every cent. The rope is still holding up too, which is surprising since it is in full sun for most of the day.

We realized this once we went through a couple of weeks with no eggs. I set up a trail camera, and sure enough, a skunk went in the house every night, ate the eggs, and left before the door closed, with one of our ducks chasing it out every night.

It was a big help once I connected a Meross Outdoor Smart Plug. I used to have to change the time on the electronic clock every couple of weeks or so to open near sunrise and sunset, but now I only do this a few times a year.
